review: Where does it say that. I have been asking that of this catalog for four months, quietly, against the text, and I want to record that this album survives it. "Olive Root and Grafted Branch" is Romans 11:17-21 and it keeps the warning attached to the promise, which is the whole point of the passage and the thing every other song on this theme drops. I was raised in a church that turned out to be a personality cult and I was seventeen before anybody told me. So I check. I know what I look like. Five stars, and this is the first album here I have not had to qualify.
